narr: Numerous showers and thunderstorms developed across East Tennessee, during the afternoon and evening hours of June 27th. These storms produced mainly scattered wind damage, but also caused some flash flooding in Tennessee.
ev: Broadcast media shared a video that showed a large ditch and culvert overflowing with water, along with water nearly a foot deep running through the parking lot of the Northshore Village apartment complex near intersection of Memorial Drive and Altamont Road in the Red Bank area.
lsr: Overflowing ditches and parking lot flooding.
